correctness.rationale: For any integer k>=2 and all positive prices Pj,Qj and total budget B, Kirchhoff index is N trace(L^+), strictly convex in unconstrained positive semidefinite Laplacian restricted to 1-perp; distinct edge weights determine different matrices. Reflections of each C4 petal force two equal hub conductances uj and two equal distal vj at the unique optimum; zeroed whole orbits disconnect, so positivity follows. Series-parallel resistance plus cut-vertex addition yields K=sum_j Cj(tj)/bj, tj=uj/vj>0, bj=2Pjuj+2Qjvj, E=3k-2. Cj derivative has asserted quartic Hj/(tj²(tj+1)²), one positive simple root by Descartes (sign sequence +,+,±,-,-) and coercive endpoint limits. Budget Cauchy–Schwarz gives bj=B sqrt(Cj)/sum sqrt(Cj), K*=(sum sqrt(Cj))²/B; same-class prices give tj=sqrt(3E/(E+2)). Independent direct inverse-grounded-Laplacian computation k=2 B=12 P/Q=(1,4),(4,1): K=35.21370863484188 equals formula 35.2137086348419. The all-real-parameter theorem is analytic, not derived from numerical tests.
